$comment: WHY ELEVEN FAMILIES DO NOT REALIZE — MECHANISM ESTABLISHED.
D4.32 classified the eleven by blocking rule and refused to call the classification a diagnosis.
This record answers the four factual questions that were left open, by reading the evaluator
rather than inferring from behaviour, and by running the two rules against all forty members.
It stops at the mechanism. Whether the scoping SHOULD change, and to what, is an authored legal
and product decision and is not made here.
kind: PRODUCT FINDING — the first to come out of the measurement work

the_four_questions.q: Does the constraint evaluator consult documentShape?
the_four_questions.evidence: IRE/src/indian-rule-engine/constraintEngine.js imports documentShape and ruleAppliesToDocType reads it to honour excludes_shapes.

the_four_questions.q: What happens when a constraint declares no applicable document type or shape?
the_four_questions.evidence: `if (!Array.isArray(rule.applies_to_doc_types)) return true;` — an undeclared scope is universal, not empty.

the_four_questions.q: Is applicability evaluated before the assertion?
the_four_questions.evidence: ruleAppliesToDocType is checked first and the loop continues past the rule before any assertion runs.

the_four_questions.q: Does the system distinguish NOT APPLICABLE from FAILED ASSERTION?
the_four_questions.a: YES, and it distinguishes a third state too.
the_four_questions.evidence: Outcomes are recorded as not_applicable, no_assertion, pass or fail. A rule with neither assert nor fails_if is recorded as no_assertion rather than treated as vacuously passing.

reading: THE MACHINERY IS SOUND. Every distinction this question needed already exists in the evaluator,
and the scoping vocabulary is real and in use — corporate and finance declare applies_to_doc_types,
general_provisions and execution_authority declare excludes_doc_types and excludes_shapes.
The finding is in the DECLARATIONS. contract.constraints.json carries 3 rules and
employment.constraints.json carries 10, and not one of the 13 declares any scoping at all.
Undeclared means universal, so all 13 are evaluated against all 40 families.

measurement.$method: Ran contract and employment rules through runConstraints for every registry family with no clauses present, and read the recorded outcome.
measurement.reading: Neither rule is ever recorded not_applicable. An affidavit is required to have lawful consideration and a POSH policy to define an employee's role, because nothing tells the evaluator otherwise.

falsification.requirement: Any account of the eleven has to explain BOTH halves — the five that are not agreement-shaped and the six that are.
how: SHAPE-INAPPROPRIATE (5): POWER_OF_ATTORNEY, AFFIDAVIT and INDEMNITY_BOND are SWORN, POSH_POLICY
is POLICY, ARBITRATION_NOTICE is NOTICE. A rule about bargains reaches them because it declares
SEPARATION_AGREEMENT are AGREEMENT-shaped and are not employment contracts. PROMISSORY_NOTE and
IP_ASSIGNMENT_AGREEMENT likewise are not the instruments their blocking rules describe. Shape
would not have excluded any of them; applies_to_doc_types would.
falsification.$why_this_matters: A shape-only explanation would have covered five of eleven and read as a complete account. The control the earlier record insisted on is what forced the second half into view.

what_is_NOT_established: That the rules are wrong. A rule firing on an instrument is not the same as the instrument being entitled to omit what the rule requires, and the answer differs per instrument — consideration is genuinely irrelevant to an affidavit and genuinely central to a promissory note.
That the eleven SHOULD generate. Membership in the population does not settle whether the family's current knowledge is complete.
Which of the thirteen rules needs scoping, or whether scoping is the right repair at all rather than, say, the families carrying the clauses the rules look for.
why_it_bites_only_eleven: The rules fail for all forty when no clauses are present. Twenty-nine families nonetheless generate, because their clause sets happen to contain a clause that satisfies the rule. So the over-broad scope is universal and the BLOCK is not: it lands where the family has no satisfying clause, which is exactly where the rule was least appropriate.

decision_required.question: For each of the 13 rules in contract.constraints.json and employment.constraints.json, which document types or shapes is it a rule about?
decision_required.$constraint: Not a mechanical repair. Each answer is a statement about which instruments a statutory requirement governs, and s.25 of the Contract Act does not reach an affidavit for the same reason it does reach a promissory note.
